title: Add RecipeDetailSheet root assembly
description: Create RecipeDetailSheet.swift. Assembles all component views into a single sheet: RecipeHeroHeader (passing a dismiss closure), RecipeStatStrip, RecipeTagChips, a Picker(.segmented) with segments 'Ingredients' / 'Cookware' / 'Steps' defaulting to Ingredients, the active tab view, and RecipeBottomBar pinned at the bottom. Owns @State currentScale (Scale, default .one) passed as a binding to IngredientsView's header picker and RecipeBottomBar. Owns @State selectedTab. Accepts a Recipe and is presented via .sheet(item:).
acceptance_criteria: Sheet uses .large detent with working swipe-down dismiss.
RecipeHeroHeader dismiss button calls the sheet dismiss action.
Single @State currentScale flows as a binding to both IngredientsView's header picker and RecipeBottomBar.
Segmented picker defaults to Ingredients tab.
Switching tabs shows the correct component view.
RecipeBottomBar is always visible at the bottom.
Gathered state in IngredientsView resets on sheet re-presentation (non-persistent).

handoff_summary.completed: Created CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipeDetailSheet.swift: owns @State currentScale: RecipeScale = .one and @State selectedTab: RecipeTab = .ingredients, loads Recipe asynchronously from RecipeFile.url via CooklangParser, assembles RecipeHeroHeader (with dismiss closure) + RecipeStatStrip + RecipeTagChips + segmented Picker + tab-switched content (IngredientsView/CookwareView/StepsView) + pinned RecipeBottomBar. Uses .presentationDetents([.large]) for large-detent swipe-dismiss. Updated RecipesListView.swift: replaced 14-line placeholder sheet block with a single RecipeDetailSheet(recipe:) call. Regenerated CookbookApp.xcodeproj with xcodegen to pick up the new file.
handoff_summary.risks: IngredientsView/CookwareView/StepsView all render List internally. Within a VStack, List height expansion relies on SwiftUI's automatic sizing; if the sheet content feels cramped on smaller devices this may need a layout pass. The gathered checkbox state resets on tab switch (not just sheet re-presentation) because the @ViewBuilder switch creates a new view instance — this matches the acceptance criterion (non-persistent) but may be surprising if the spec intended within-session persistence on tab return.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify all acceptance criteria: large detent + swipe dismiss, dismiss button, shared scale binding, segmented picker defaults, tab switching, bottom bar visibility, and gathered-state reset on re-presentation.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: RecipesListView.swift was modified to remove the placeholder sheet. Any concurrent bead editing that file would conflict. No other file overlaps expected.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: RecipeDetailSheet loads Recipe asynchronously using Task.detached + CooklangParser.canonical.parse so the UI thread is never blocked by file I/O. A ProgressView spinner is shown while parsing (replaces the tab area; RecipeBottomBar still shown underneath). RecipeTab enum is file-private to avoid polluting the module namespace. xcodegen regeneration was required because XcodeGen glob sources only reflect the xcodeproj at last-generate time.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests written (developer bead scope). Tester bead should cover: scale binding flows to both IngredientsView and RecipeBottomBar, tab switching renders correct child view, gathered state is fresh on each sheet presentation.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Visual layout (hero header height, stat strip scroll, tag chip wrap) not verified — agents cannot render UI. The recipe parser error path silently returns an empty Recipe(); a future bead could surface a user-visible error state per the ui-guidelines empty/error state rules.

conflict_risks: RecipesListView.swift was modified to remove the placeholder sheet. Any concurrent bead editing that file would conflict. No other file overlaps expected.

execution_history.summary: Created RecipeDetailSheet.swift, assembling all component views into a recipe detail sheet. Updated RecipesListView.swift to replace the placeholder sheet with RecipeDetailSheet. Regenerated xcodeproj via XcodeGen after adding the new file. Build succeeds with no errors.
